items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Don Redman Redmond was the leader of the band and we played different theaters

ctx.x: Now, let me see. That was before CBS. We did a -- travelled the Eastern circuit there for awhile, I must've been there for about six months in the bad. Don Redman Redmond was the leader of the band and we played different theaters, Earle Theater in Washington and different theaters around that area.
